devicesMFE.py.summary: DevicesMFE is a Page Object Model class for HP Smart web application's device management MFE (Micro Frontend). It extends SmartFlow and implements the Page Object pattern with clear separation between verification flows and action flows. Notable patterns include: (1) Extensive use of wait_for_object with configurable timeouts and exception handling, (2) Multi-screen popup navigation support for What's New feature with getter methods for text validation, (3) JavaScript executor usage for interacting with hidden elements, (4) Keyboard interaction using Selenium Keys for page refresh, (5) Alpha/dummy printer testing workaround for environments where actual printers cannot be added, (6) Consistent method naming conventions (verify_*, click_*, get_*), (7) Support for both visible and invisible element verification, (8) Comprehensive coverage of device card interactions, navigation elements, and user authentication states. The class demonstrates enterprise-level test automation practices with robust error handling and flexible timeout configurations.
